items.source: Constructs a new instance of the PropertyValueConversionService initialized with the given, required CustomConversions for resolving the PropertyValueConversions used to convert PersistentProperty values during data access operations.
items.translation: 构建一个新的PropertyValueConversionService实例，该实例使用给定的、必需的CustomConversions进行初始化，用于解析在数据访问操作期间转换PersistentProperty值的PropertyValueConversions。

items.source: Return true if a PropertyValueConverter is registered for the PersistentProperty.
items.translation: 如果已为PersistentProperty注册了PropertyValueConverter，则返回 true。

items.source: Convert a value from its store-native representation into its domain-specific type.
items.translation: 将值从其存储原生表示形式转换为其特定领域的类型。

items.source: Convert a value from its domain-specific value into its store-native representation.
items.translation: 将值从其特定域表示转换为存储原生表示。

items.source: value - the value to convert. Can be null.
items.translation: value - 要转换的值。可以是 null。

items.source: property - the underlying property.
items.translation: property - 底层属性。

items.source: context - the context object.
items.translation: context - 上下文对象。

items.source: If this method returns true, it means read(Object, PersistentProperty, ValueConversionContext) and write(Object, PersistentProperty, ValueConversionContext) are capable of handling conversions.
items.translation: 如果此方法返回 true，则表示read(Object, PersistentProperty, ValueConversionContext)和write(Object, PersistentProperty, ValueConversionContext)能够处理转换。

items.source: Conversion service based on CustomConversions used to convert domain and store values using property-specific converters.
items.translation: 基于 CustomConversions 的转换服务，用于通过 特定属性的转换器 来转换领域值和存储值。

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if CustomConversions is null.
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果 CustomConversions 为 null。

items.source: true if a PropertyValueConverter is registered for the PersistentProperty.
items.translation: 如果已为PersistentProperty注册了PropertyValueConverter，则为true。

items.source: conversions - CustomConversions used to handle domain and store type conversions; must not be null.
items.translation: conversions - 用于处理领域类型和存储类型转换的CustomConversions；不得为 null。

items.source: property - property to evaluate for registration.
items.translation: property - 用于评估以进行注册的property。

items.source: P - property type.
items.translation: P - 属性类型。

items.source: VCC - value conversion context type.
items.translation: VCC - 值转换上下文类型。

items.source: P - property type.
items.translation: P - 属性类型。

items.source: VCC - value conversion context type.
items.translation: VCC - 值转换上下文类型。

items.source: the value to be used in the domain model. Can be null.
items.translation: 域模型中要使用的值。可以为null。

items.source: the value to be written to the data store. Can be null.
items.translation: 要写入数据存储的值。可以为 `null`。
